HOME SCIENCE MARCH — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

2. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ventilation and Lighting? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ventilation and Lighting.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ventilation and Lighting.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Ventilation and Lighting.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ventilation and Lighting.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.

7. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Convenience Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Convenience Foods.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Convenience Foods.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Convenience Foods.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Convenience Foods.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care of the Home: Exterior Environment? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.

11. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

12. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Careers in Food and Nutrition? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Careers in Food and Nutrition.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Yeast Products? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Yeast Products.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Yeast Products.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Yeast Products.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Yeast Products.

15. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Consumer Protection? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Consumer Protection.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Consumer Protection.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Consumer Protection.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Careers in Home Management 3.0 Clothing and Textiles 3.1 Clothing Construction P and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Careers in Home Management and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Clothing Construction Processes: Collars and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
